text: The docs package is not named docs, so a generic nub run --filter docs typecheck command returns no projects matched; repository docs validation should expose a documented package/script target.
Direct rtk oxfmt invocation fails; repository formatting must use pnpm exec oxfmt
pandwind-codemod swap --help exits with an unknown-flag error instead of showing usage; document supported flags or add help handling
Panda website proof runner imported execFileSync from node:fs, so Nub failed before executing the proof; a typed script check would have caught the bad module boundary.
zsh-expanded Ark UI package globs before rg could inspect installed splitter types; a quoted or repo-local package resolver would avoid this dead end
Long CUA route sweeps time out during Page.getFrameTree; shorter batches or a bounded browser smoke helper would avoid losing partial results.
rg patterns beginning with -- need an explicit -- delimiter in our shell workflow
CUA browser evaluation timed out on a bounded multi-route preview loop without returning partial results; a streaming or per-navigation result API would make whole-playground smoke checks reliable.
The root workspace cannot resolve playground-only oxc-parser for a direct AST probe; a package-scoped dependency probe or documented workspace command would avoid this dead end.

Chrome tab creation rejected the documented visibility option during a second-route smoke check; a stable tab navigation or visibility contract would make route-by-route browser validation less brittle.
Skill files were listed under the Nix overlay but I first tried the personal skill path; the catalog should expose a directly readable resolved path.
A quoted rg pattern with nested shell quotes failed before the search ran; scoped simpler patterns are safer for JSX import tracing.
rg option ordering with the rtk wrapper produced misleading no-such-file errors when using -- before the pattern; a clearer wrapper error would prevent wasted diagnosis
A literal rg path glob with no matches made zsh abort before the type declaration search ran; a nullglob-safe search helper would avoid this
A multi-root rg scan aborted when one optional directory was absent; a missing-path-tolerant repository search helper would keep the useful matches from being obscured by the error.
A formatter command used repository-relative paths from the playground package cwd and failed with no targets; package-scoped validation should make path roots explicit.
The CUA tab did not expose a documented viewport-resize method, so responsive breakpoint checks require another browser-size mechanism.

Full repo pnpm lint is blocked by unrelated baseline errors: unused imports in packages/codemod/proof/semantic-contract-fixtures.ts and scripts/promote-panda-website.ts, plus import(default) false positives for ?raw modules in examples/example/src/examples/mixed-apis-app.tsx.

Full repo oxfmt check is blocked by five unrelated pre-existing files: docs/src/content/docs/reference/css-in-js-scorecard.md, examples/example/src/tw.d.ts, packages/codemod/src/swap/project-bootstrap.ts, packages/pandwind/src/vite/css-call-rewriter.ts, and plans/evidence/panda-website-proof.md.
CUA tab object does not expose snapshot(); the supported page-read method should be discoverable from getTab documentation or a stable tab API listing.
Playground browser probe assumed a direct playwright package, but the app only declares @playwright/test; diagnostics should use the declared package or document the dependency boundary.
playground tw:generate reformats src/types.d.ts after editor:types generates it, making editor:types:check fail after dev/build; each generator should own only its output.
Repeated playground route sweeps exhaust the browser Oxc WebAssembly parser memory and blank the tab; a resettable/lower-memory sandbox evaluator would make long audits reliable.
TypeScript 7 runtime no longer exposes ts.sys in the repository's node require path, so quick compiler-API type inspection needs an explicit fs/host fallback

The repository-wide lint command is not currently green: it reports unrelated unused imports, ?raw default-import checks, and pre-existing raw parser identity diagnostics outside the at-rule changes. A focused lint target or baseline suppressions would make feature validation actionable.
The skill validation command assumes python, but this workstation exposes python3 only; the skill workflow should document or resolve the executable consistently.
The bundled skill quick validator imports PyYAML, but the host Python environment lacks yaml; validation needs the documented Nix-backed dependency path.
